subject: general
question: Gir forest, which is famous for the Asiatic lion, is located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Gir Forests**, th**e biggest contiguous area of dry deciduous forests** in the semi-arid western section of India, are home to the only remaining population of the** Asiatic lion (Panthera leo persica).**
 
• In **1965**, it was designated as a sanctuary.
 
• The majority of people associate Gir with** "Maldharis,"** a species that has endured through the millennia thanks to a symbiotic association with the lion.
 
• They reside in Gir and are** pastoral religious communities.** Their settlements are referred to as **"nesses."​**
